t: ShankhNaad can show messages in your language, and voice notes as text.
In this video, you will learn how to pick your language and translate a message.
Open your profile menu and choose your language.
Choose Translate to, and pick your language. Translations then use it.
Point at a message and press the translate button.
The translation shows under the message. It is saved, so the same message is only translated once.
Under voice notes and audio files, Show text gives you a written transcript.
Languages are turned on by your admin.
Next in the Alerts & settings menu: Calls, reminders and notifications.
